source.caution:

- 특정 원료 성분에 알레르기 체질은 원료 성분을 확인 후 섭취하십시오.

Health Functional FoodManganese 3mgVitamin B12 2.4μgVitamin B6 1.5mgVitamin D 125μgVitamin K 140μgFolate 680μgOnce a day

비타민K2 & D3 프리미엄 MK-7 미니정Manganese · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin D · Vitamin K · Folate

Made by 일양약품(주) · Once a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 3mg of Manganese, 2.4μg of Vitamin B12, 1.5mg of Vitamin B6, 125μg of Vitamin D, 140μg of Vitamin K, 680μg of Folate as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 3mg Manganese, 2.4μg Vitamin B12, 1.5mg Vitamin B6, 125μg Vitamin D, 140μg Vitamin K, 680μg Folate
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 일양약품(주)

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Manganese
    • Needed for bone formation
    • Needed for energy utilisation
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Vitamin K
    • Needed for normal blood clotting
    • Needed for the structure of bone
  • Folate
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 tablet per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Manganese labelled (3mg / 300mg), 80~150%
Vitamin B12 labelled (2.4μg / 300mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (1.5mg / 300mg), 80~150%
Vitamin D labelled (125μg / 300mg), 80~180%
Vitamin K labelled (140μg / 300mg), 80~180%
Folate labelled (680μg / 300mg), 80~120%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 흰노란색의 원형 코팅정제
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage 직사광선 및 고온다습한 곳을 피해 습기가 적고 서늘한 실온에 보관, 유통하십시오. 어린이 손에 닿지 않는 곳에 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Manganese · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin D · Vitamin K · Folate together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Consult a professional if you have hypercalcaemia or take medication · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product
